name: mods
description: One place to see the mods installed on this machine, with name, version, description and enabled state, an on/off control per mod, and an Open button for mods that have their own pane.

allowWithoutBackup.title: Allow changes without a backup
allowWithoutBackup.description: By default the mod refuses to change your settings file if it cannot first save a backup copy next to it. Turn this on to accept the change anyway when the backup fails.
